states.content: Nadia Lopez's family access has been fully revoked as she requested, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions; the revocation is logged, and no family medical access remains. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Transportation contact is now patient direct contact only, not routed through family. states.content: Bowel prep instructions: item one is clear liquids on Sunday; item two is the second dose of the split prep at 4:00 AM Monday; item three is no solid food after midnight. states.content: Nadia Lopez requests that family access be revoked completely now, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions, and asks to confirm that family is fully removed from reminders. Nurse Imani confirmed that family is fully removed from Nadia's reminders and contact routing. She previously requested that communication be limited to ride times and check-in instructions, that diagnosis details be kept off family messages, and that family messages include only the check-in rules, not the reason for the workup; she also asks that her callback route be kept private. Detailed results of the likely source evaluation are to stay with Nadia only.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Nadia Lopez wants to be contacted only directly through herself and the patient portal from here forward, unless there is an emergency, and she wants this contact plan kept going forward. She does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Her direct mobile 415-555-0191 remains confirmed and active as the primary route, and the portal is acceptable. River House must not reappear anywhere, including in communications, forms and routing; the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes, the backup route is no longer to be used, and Nadia asks that it not be resurrected in any reminder. She asks that her callback route be kept private and considers the exact wording of the contact note important. She agrees that the transportation note (the transportation voucher sent to Nadia only) sounds right.
